title: Indian-Style Jalebi Bread Bites
description: A twist on traditional Indian jalebi, these crispy bread bites make a delicious snack or side dish. Serve warm with a dollop of yogurt or a sprinkle of powdered sugar.

ingredients.name: dumplings
ingredients.notes: flour or bread-based dumplings work best

ingredients.name: jalebi
ingredients.notes: or make from scratch with gram flour, sugar, and spices

instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 350°F (180°C).
Cut bread into 1-inch cubes and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together wrapped dumplings, jalebi, ginger, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Dip each bread cube into the mixture, coating evenly.
Fry bread bites in batches until golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain on paper towels and serve warm with yogurt or powdered sugar.
Optional: serve with a side of sweet chutney or raita (yogurt with cucumber and cumin).
Adjust spice level to taste by adding more cayenne pepper or omitting it altogether.
For an extra crunchy coating, sprinkle a pinch of gram flour or cornstarch on fried bread bites before serving.
Experiment with different types of dumplings or bread for unique textures and flavors.
For a lighter version, bake bread bites in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 10-12 minutes, or until crispy and golden.
Store leftover bread bites in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
